additional_cdm_data_for_drafts.undiagnosed_diabetes_5_9pct: 5.9% of adults have raised blood glucose but are NOT known diabetics — supports PP1.2 (undetected NCD at lab routing) and PP1.3 (CDM recall gap for newly identified patients)
additional_cdm_data_for_drafts.undiagnosed_hypertension_11_9pct: 11.9% of adults have raised blood pressure but are NOT known hypertensives — largest undiagnosed gap among the three NCDs
additional_cdm_data_for_drafts.undiagnosed_hypercholesterolaemia_18_1pc: 18.1% of adults have raised cholesterol but are NOT known to have hypercholesterolaemia — majority of hypercholesterolaemia cases are undetected
additional_cdm_data_for_drafts.ncd_screening_57pct: 57.2% had NCD health screening in past year, meaning ~43% of the at-risk adult population is not being screened annually
additional_cdm_data_for_drafts.medical_checkup_34_6pct: Only 34.6% of adults utilised medical check-up in the last 12 months — supports PP1.3 poor recall and follow-up rates
